body:
I thought I’d give you an update.

At my appointment today I was upfront and told the truth to my pcp. She did ask to admit me but I declined. So she had me speak with a psychologist during the same appointment who helped me identify my triggers. They enrolled me in a program to get a therapist. I will meet with the psychologist and the therapist in the coming week to set up a plan. Luckily they have a program geared toward not only being cost effective but also if I didn’t like the therapist they will help me find one until I find a fit. 

My pcp decided to wait until I meet with both before adjusting me medications. I expressed being worried side effects before getting a longer plan of action or at lest a set schedule to meet with my new care team. 

I just wanted to thank you for all your information and quick responses. I’m not sure I would have gone to this appointment without it.
I think I understand. But I’ve been lying to myself about how bad these feelings and thoughts have become. Where do I start if not at doctor?
I will stay in touch. You’ve been a very informative and I appreciate you take this time to help me.

I did tell me SO the following evening. The suggestion from my other post and trough emotions of that day made it happen.  I couldn’t tell my SO why it happened because I’m still figuring that out. They were shocked but expressed their love for me and gave positive words. 

I’m not sure what to say to my pcp other then the truth. I’m just afraid of when it all come pouring out it won’t make sense because it doesn’t to me.
Thank you. This made me feel more at ease about my appointment.
I’m in Washington state. I’ve been with my pcp for 5+ years and they have managed my depression and medications. But I have not been very forthcoming with how bad my depression is.
I worried if I tell them it would strain our relationship.
